source.note: Login is not in Interface.xdat. The screen is built by the function at 0x1013D810. Child rects come from NCAuthWnd::OnCreate (0x1017F9A0) and NCLoginFunctionWnd::OnCreate (0x1017DD60). Screen anchors are the vtable+0xD0 values (mode, x, y). Mode numbers are the xdat Alignment enum: 1 TOP_LEFT, 2 TOP_CENTER, 5 CENTER, 9 BOTTOM_RIGHT. The anchor resolver is 0x1005C570.

deviations.what: The original draws %s_LogoTexture, falling back to L2Font.start_logo-k, in a 256x256 box. Fineage keeps the existing wordmark texture Data/UI/Login/fineage-logo-white and only uses the original anchor and box.

Not an original login control. It is drawn with the option-window checkbox. OptionWnd / GameTab / VideoTab / AudioTab checkboxes leave checkTexture and unCheckTexture undefined, so the client uses the default L2UI.Control.CheckBox (16x16, DXT5, object at serial offset 1086692) and L2UI.Control.CheckBox_checked (serial offset 14901324). It sits in the gap under the password edit: the edit is (84, 42, 128, 17) so it ends at y=59, and the buttons start at y=72. The mark is 12px tall, the option-tab checkbox height (GameTab NameBox height 12), because a 16px mark does not fit that 13px gap. Unchecked and checked use the default textures. There is no hover texture on the default checkbox.

gaps.name: MiniLogo
gaps.recovered: Built in 0x1013D810 from %s_MiniLogoTexture / L2Font.start_minilogo-k. Scale floats at 0x1027A278 (232) and 0x1027A27C (120). Anchor mode 1 TOP_LEFT, offset (0, 0).

gaps.name: OTP login
gaps.recovered: NCAuthWnd::OnCreate calls 0x1013F8D0. When it returns nonzero the back texture is L2UI_CH3.LoginWnd.otplogon_back and the window height passed to SetPosition is 128 (0x80) instead of 108 (0x6C). An extra edit is created at (84, 64, 128, 17), control id 0x112211F1. A button uses L2UI_CH3.LoginWnd.aboutotpicon / aboutotpicon_down, control id 0x112211F0. Login and Exit then use y=92 (0x5C) instead of y=72 (0x48). When the call returns zero those controls are hidden (vtable +0x134).
gaps.fineage: Not shown. The compiled window is the 108px path.

gaps.name: Centered 546x425 windows
gaps.recovered: The same builder constructs further windows (stored at esi+0x1E0, esi+0x1E4, esi+0x1E8) with SetPosition size 0x222 x 0x1A9 (546x425) and top-left (screenW/2 - 273, screenH/2 - 212). 273 and 212 are the doubles at 0x1027A250 and 0x1027A258. The following anchor call is mode 5 CENTER, offset (0, 0). Class names were not recovered from the strings in this function.

gaps.name: NCLoginServerWnd
gaps.recovered: Ctor 0x1013D5B0 is called from 0x1013E186 inside the login builder. Its OnCreate is 0x1017E5D0. The screen rect past that call was not reduced to a single anchor in this pass.

gaps.name: Login menu captions
gaps.recovered: NCLoginFunctionWnd buttons use sysstring ids 154 (0x9A), 155 (0x9B), 156 (0x9C), 805 (0x325), 1251 (0x4E3), top to bottom. NCAuthWnd login button uses 152 (0x98) and exit uses 153 (0x99). sysstring-e.dat is still Lineage2Ver413, so the caption text was not decoded.
gaps.fineage: The existing localized button captions are left in place. They are not claimed as the decoded sysstrings.

gaps.name: Auth field labels
gaps.recovered: The account and password edits are controls. The words beside them are drawn in OnPaint (0x1017F390), which was not reduced to a label rect in this pass.
gaps.fineage: The existing account and password labels stay in the row. Their coordinates are not claimed as extracted.

windows.name: LoginLogoWnd
windows.evidence: 0x1013D810 sets both axes from the float at 0x1027A2D8 (256) via vtable +0x128, then vtable +0xD0 with mode 2, x=0, y=50 (0x32). Original texture name %s_LogoTexture, fallback L2Font.start_logo-k. Fineage does not bind that texture; see deviations.

windows.name: NCAuthWnd
windows.evidence: 0x1013D810 SetPosition: x = screenW * 0.5 - 128, y = screenH * 0.5 - 54, size 256x108 when 0x1013F8D0 returns zero (doubles 0.5 at 0x1022C1F8, 128 at 0x1027A268, 54 at 0x1027A260). Anchor stored afterwards is mode 5 CENTER, offset (0, 0). OTP path uses height 128 and y = screenH * 0.5 - 64 (double 64 at 0x1027A270) with otplogon_back; see gaps.

controls.name: LoginButton
controls.evidence: OnCreate: BigButton / bigbutton_down, SetRect x=0x1F y=0x48 (OTP y=0x5C) w=0x60 h=0x17, then sysstring 0x98.

controls.name: ExitButton
controls.evidence: OnCreate SetRect x=0x83, same y/size as the login button, then sysstring 0x99.

windows.name: NCLoginFunctionWnd
windows.evidence: OnPaint draws lobby_menuback at (0,0) size 120x138. Builder SetPosition x=screenW-154, y=screenH-200, then anchor mode 9, x=-34 (0xFFFFFFDE), y=-62 (0xFFFFFFC2) at 0x1013DDD1. Right margin 34 and bottom margin 62 follow from that anchor for a 120x138 window.
